analysis.evidence: וַיְהִי introduces the episode impersonally. The כַּאֲשֶׁר clause sets the time, as Abram drew near to Egypt, and וַיֹּאמֶר gives the main event, his speech to Sarai.
analysis.morphology: The prefixed conjunction וַ introduces יְהִי, the short third-person masculine singular Qal form of הָיָה, in a wayyiqtol construction.
